name: Short Horse 44
author: PriyanshuGupta28
description: Gradient cyan button that glows and scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes scale(1.05), box-shadow becomes 0px 3px 6px #000000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Short Horse 44</title>
<style>
/* Short Horse 44 by PriyanshuGupta28 — https://uiverse.io/PriyanshuGupta28/short-horse-44 */
.swipe-button {
  padding: 10px 20px;
  font-size: 18px;
  border: none;
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #3498db, #e74c3c, #9b59b6, #2ecc71);
  background-size: 200% 200%;
  background-position: 0 0;
  color: white;
  border-radius: 5px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: sans-serif;
  transition: background-position 0.5s ease-in-out, transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
}

.swipe-button:hover {
  background-position: 100% 100%;
  transform: scale(1.05);
  box-shadow: 0px 3px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

.swipe-button:active {
  transform: translateY(2px);
  color: #fff;

}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="swipe-button">Hover Me</button>

</body>
</html>
